accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Polavaram Project:
1. The Union Government bears 100 per cent of the remaining cost of its irrigation component from 1 April 2014.
2. The Government of Andhra Pradesh executes the irrigation component on behalf of the Government of India.
3. Andhra Pradesh may seek reimbursement or advances for the expenditure incurred.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Centre funds the remaining irrigation cost from 1 April 2014, while Andhra Pradesh executes the component and seeks reimbursement or advances.
accepted.tq: Test the complete funding-and-execution chain rather than isolating only the funding share.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Polavaram feature)
a. Earth-cum-rock fill dam
b. Spillway
c. Irrigation potential

i. 2.91 lakh hectares
ii. 1,121.20 metres
iii. 2,467.50 metres

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The dam is 2,467.50 metres long, the spillway is 1,121.20 metres long, and the irrigation potential is 2.91 lakh hectares.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure numerical pair and eliminate codes that reverse the dam and spillway dimensions.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s: The irrigation potential of the Polavaram Project extends over which set of erstwhile districts?
o: East Godavari, Visakhapatnam, West Godavari and Krishna
accepted.x: The stated irrigation coverage is 2.91 lakh hectares in erstwhile East Godavari, Visakhapatnam, West Godavari and Krishna districts.
accepted.tq: Test the location list as a grouped geographical recall question.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s: Which institution cleared the structural safety of the new spillway blocks of the Polavaram Project in April 2026?
accepted.x: The Central Water Commission cleared the structural safety of the new spillway blocks, in line with the Dam Safety Act, 2021.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who performs this function?’ test to distinguish the water-safety authority from allied bodies.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the budgetary allocations connected with completion of the Polavaram Project?
o: Union Budget 2026–27: ₹3,320 crore; Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27: ₹55,548 crore
Union Budget 2026–27: ₹3,320 crore; Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27: ₹6,105 crore
Union Budget 2026–27: ₹55,548 crore; Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27: ₹6,105 crore
Union Budget 2026–27: ₹6,105 crore; Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27: ₹3,320 crore
accepted.x: The Union Budget 2026–27 provided ₹3,320 crore towards the revised cost, while the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27 provided ₹6,105 crore. ₹55,548 crore was the older estimated cost.
accepted.tq: Split current allocations from the older estimated cost and match each figure to the correct government.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s: The Union Budget 2026–27 allocation for Polavaram was linked to completion with storage up to which level?
accepted.x: The Union allocation of ₹3,320 crore was linked to the revised cost for completion with storage up to +41.15 metres.
accepted.tq: Use precise numerical discrimination among closely spaced levels.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as a source of friction in the implementation of the Polavaram Project?
o: Delays in rehabilitation and resettlement funding
Shortage of coal for thermal power generation
accepted.x: The identified difficulties are revised cost estimates, land acquisition and delays in rehabilitation and resettlement funding. Coal shortage is not listed as an implementation issue here.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the stated implementation constraints rather than choosing a broadly plausible project problem.
accepted.sec: Polavaram in APRA 2014 - section, status, executing authority, clearances

accepted.s: Who chairs the Apex Council constituted under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act?
o: The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh
The Union Minister of Water Resources or Jal Shakti
accepted.x: The Apex Council is chaired by the Union Minister of Water Resources, now functioning under the Jal Shakti portfolio. It is not chaired by the Prime Minister or Home Minister.
accepted.tq: Use the authority trap by distinguishing the designated portfolio from other senior Union offices.
accepted.sec: Apex Council and river boards (GRMB, KRMB) - chair, members, functions

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Apex Council:
1. The Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana are its members.
2. It was constituted under Section 84 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act.
3. It supervises the Godavari River Management Board and the Krishna River Management Board.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Apex Council includes the two Chief Ministers, is constituted under Section 84 and supervises GRMB and KRMB.
accepted.tq: Check membership, statutory basis and function separately before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Apex Council and river boards (GRMB, KRMB) - chair, members, functions

accepted.s: The functions of GRMB and KRMB include regulation of water and power supply from notified projects in accordance with:
o: The awards of the concerned tribunals
The recommendations of the Election Commission
The decisions of State Legislatures alone
accepted.x: The river boards regulate water and power supply from notified projects according to tribunal awards. Their jurisdiction was notified on 15 July 2021.
accepted.tq: Match the regulatory function with the legal basis rather than with an unrelated constitutional body.
accepted.sec: Apex Council and river boards (GRMB, KRMB) - chair, members, functions

accepted.s:
Match the Thirteenth Schedule commitment with its associated location or status:

a. Integrated steel plant
b. Crude oil refinery and petrochemical complex
c. New railway zone
d. Metro rail

i. Kakinada region
ii. South Coast Railway with headquarters at Visakhapatnam
iii. Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada–Guntur–Tenali region
iv. YSR Kadapa district

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The steel plant is associated with YSR Kadapa, the refinery and petrochemical complex with Kakinada, the railway zone with Visakhapatnam headquarters, and metro rail with the Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada–Guntur–Tenali region.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive railway-zone and steel-plant locations, then complete the remaining pairs.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure → location

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding infrastructure commitments is correct?
1. The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor has made progress without delay.
2. The South Coast Railway was announced in 2019 with headquarters at Visakhapatnam.
3. The crude oil refinery and petrochemical complex is associated with the Kakinada region.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Progress on the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor has been slow, so statement 1 is false.
accepted.tq: Locate the false trend statement by testing the word ‘without delay’ against the stated progress status.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure → location

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Central Tribal University is located at Vizianagaram, not Nellore. IISER is at Tirupati, IIITDM at Kurnool and the Central University at Anantapur.
accepted.tq: Use a location mismatch to identify the single incorrectly paired institution.
accepted.sec: Central institutions under APRA → location

accepted.s: The Petroleum University, established as the Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy, is located at:
accepted.x: The Petroleum University, or IIPE, is located at Visakhapatnam. It was established by an Act of Parliament in 2017.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the institution’s formal identity and location from other central institutions in the State.
accepted.sec: Central institutions under APRA → location

accepted.s: The southern campus of the National Institute of Disaster Management under the institutional arrangements is located in:
accepted.x: The southern campus of the National Institute of Disaster Management is located in Krishna district.
accepted.tq: Test the district-level location separately from city-based institutional locations.
accepted.sec: Central institutions under APRA → location

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding central institutions in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. The Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy was set up by an Act of 2017.
2. The Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh was established through the Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2019.
3. Both institutions are described as having failed to take off.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The description that IIPE and the Central Tribal University failed to take off is outdated; both institutions were established through the stated legal measures.
accepted.tq: Reject the outdated-status trap while retaining the two precise statutory facts.
accepted.sec: Central institutions under APRA → location

accepted.s: Under the general principle for division of assets and liabilities between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, which basis was applied respectively to assets and liabilities?
o: Assets on population basis and liabilities on location basis
Assets on location basis and liabilities on population basis
Both assets and liabilities on area basis
Both assets and liabilities on revenue-contribution basis
accepted.x: Assets were generally divided on the basis of location, whereas liabilities or debt were divided on the basis of population.
accepted.tq: Test the reversed-comparison trap by keeping the basis for assets separate from that for liabilities.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh received about 46 per cent of revenue despite having about 58.32 per cent of the population.
2. Andhra Pradesh received a disproportionate share of debt.
3. Power was shared on the basis of the last five years’ average consumption.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The division involved about 46 per cent of revenue for Andhra Pradesh, a disproportionate debt burden, and power sharing based on the last five years’ average consumption.
accepted.tq: Combine the general financial principle with the separate revenue and power-sharing facts.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s: Treasury and bank cash balances under Section 49 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act were divided on the basis of:
accepted.x: Treasury and bank cash balances under Section 49 were divided according to the population ratio.
accepted.tq: Match the statutory section with its exact allocation basis.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s: Securities from the Cash Balances Investment Account and funds in the Seventh Schedule Public Account under Section 52 were divided on the basis of:
accepted.x: Both the securities from the Cash Balances Investment Account and the Seventh Schedule Public Account funds under Section 52 were divided on the population basis.
accepted.tq: Separate the population-basis financial items from the area- and location-basis items.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s:
Which of the following is correctly matched?

1. Calamity Relief Fund investments — Area ratio
2. Tax arrears under Section 50 — Place of assessment
3. Tax refunds under Section 56 — Population ratio

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three pairs are correct. Calamity Relief Fund investments used the area ratio, tax arrears the place of assessment, and tax refunds the population ratio.
accepted.tq: Match each item to its allocation basis instead of applying one uniform rule to all financial entries.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s: Schedule IX corporations were divided between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana using which combination?
o: Operational units by population ratio and headquarters by area ratio
Operational units by location and headquarters by population ratio
Both operational units and headquarters by location
Both operational units and headquarters by population ratio
accepted.x: For Schedule IX corporations under Section 53, operational units were allocated by location, while headquarters were allocated according to the population ratio.
accepted.tq: Split the rule into its two components because the operational-unit and headquarters bases are different.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s: The approximate loss to Andhra Pradesh through the population-ratio treatment of tax refunds under Section 56 was:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh’s loss through the tax-refund division was approximately ₹3,900 crore, as associated with the Fourteenth Finance Commission period.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the tax-refund loss from the separate Polavaram budget figures.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s: Although Andhra Pradesh accounted for about 58 per cent of the population, it received what share of power under the last five years’ average-consumption basis?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh had about 58 per cent of the population but received only 46 per cent of the power under the stated sharing basis.
accepted.tq: Use the reversed-share trap by separating the population percentage from the actual power share.
accepted.sec: Division of assets and liabilities - cash, Seventh Schedule funds

accepted.s:
Section 46 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act provides for which of the following?
1. Consideration of successor-state resources by the Fourteenth Finance Commission.
2. Grants and a special development package for backward areas.
3. Particular attention to Rayalaseema and the north coastal districts.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Section 46 covers all three matters: consideration of successor-state resources, grants and a special development package, with particular attention to Rayalaseema and the north coastal districts.
accepted.tq: Check the section against its complete cluster of related financial and regional commitments.
accepted.sec: APRA financial provisions - section → provision

accepted.s:
Match the provision with the relevant section of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act:

a. Tax incentives and fiscal measures for industrialisation
b. Development of backward areas through physical and social infrastructure
c. Special financial support for the new capital
d. Denotification of degraded forest land for the capital

i. Section 94(4)
ii. Section 94(2)
iii. Section 94(1)
iv. Section 94(3)

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Section 94(1) concerns industrialisation incentives, Section 94(2) backward-area infrastructure, Section 94(3) support for the new capital, and Section 94(4) denotification of degraded forest land.
accepted.tq: Use the sequence of sub-sections and eliminate codes that shift the provision by one clause.
accepted.sec: APRA financial provisions - section → provision

accepted.s: Which statement best describes the implementation of incentives under Section 94 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act?
o: No fiscal or tax incentives were provided under Section 94.
The incentives were converted entirely into loans by the Union Government.
All incentives sought by Andhra Pradesh were granted in full.
The incentives were granted only partly and fell short of Andhra Pradesh’s demand.
accepted.x: The incentives under Section 94 were granted only partly and were less than what Andhra Pradesh had sought.
accepted.tq: Avoid the extreme ‘all’ and ‘none’ alternatives and identify the qualified implementation statement.
accepted.sec: APRA financial provisions - section → provision
